card.name: Linking words before sex hormone names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, or, than, plus, containing, or an opening parenthesis, right before a sex hormone name like testosterone, progestin, or ethinyl estradiol. Seen in contraceptive and estrogen label text.

modes.label: Of before a hormone
modes.description: The word of after a noun like conversion, addition, or concentrations, with a hormone coming next.
modes.example: the addition<< of>> progestin should be considered.

modes.label: Other linkers
modes.description: Words like or, than, plus, or containing that lead into a hormone or hormone abbreviation.
modes.example: estrogen<< plus>> progestin substudy reported an increased

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next word being a hormone or steroid name, and away from words starting with inter-.
card.plain: It fires on small joining words just before a sex hormone such as progestin or testosterone is named.
